text:
maria_marketing: Quick sync — finalizing release announcement for Redwood Optimize v2. Can we lock changelog + docs links and confirm canary timing? Planning to publish post + benchmark thread + webinar invite at 13:00 PT on Tue. @sam_eng @liam_prod

sam_eng: Ack. Changelog is ready; PR merged -> https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog/optimize-v2. Two minor notes inline, but not release-blocking. Canary window we requested: Tue 08:00–10:00 PT.

liam_prod: Webinar slot confirmed 13:00 PT with product demos. We want benchmark narrative to call out ~2x throughput improvement on mixed workloads vs. previous gen. Marketing will draft language and share numbers.

devon_se: Can we move canary to 09:00–11:00 instead? Infra has maintenance at 07:00 so earlier is risky. Also will monitor latency SLOs and KV cache hit rate during canary.

maria_marketing: Updated: set canary 09:00–11:00 PT. Final docs link for blog + benchmarks: https://handbook.redwood.ai/launch/optimize-v2 (will publish at 13:00). Changelog link in post points to the docs above.

sam_eng: Confirming rolling canary will use model-variant v2-q8 with fallback to v2-q4. I'll paste rollout commands for ops:
```
rwdctl rollout start --env prod --bundle optimize-v2 --canary 10% --window 2h
```

oncall_bot: Pager rotation note: primary oncall during canary -> @devon_se, secondary -> @sam_eng. Monitoring hooks enabled.

maria_marketing: Inbound lead routing — we want webinar signups to go to SFDC queue "Launch_Ops" and demo requests to "AE_inbound". @liam_prod can you validate the webhook and mapping?

liam_prod: Webhook validated; leads will carry utm params: utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=optimize_v2. Demo requests flagged with tag=high_touch and routed to AE_inbound. I'll drop the webhook URL in the runbook.

devon_se: I'll watch traces and scatter by p50/p95. If p95 latency > 250ms for 5 consecutive minutes, auto-rollback trigger is enabled. Also monitoring cache hit rate — if < 60% we throttle canary.

sam_eng: Setting auto-rollback flag and smoke check script:
```
rwdctl validate --route /generate --p95 250ms
```

maria_marketing: Copy — I'll queue the scheduled publish at 13:00 PT, attach webinar link and benchmark thread. Also prepping a short FAQ for support (routing + demo handoff). If anything changes ping here. :thumbsup:

sam_eng: :thumbsup: I'll be available 08:30–12:30 PT. Ping me if rollout logs show >2% error rate.

liam_prod: Sending demo routing playbook to #support and #sales-ops now. Good luck all — excited to get this out. :rocket:
